subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should the Control UI intentionally change Nostr profile imports from immediate persistence to review-only drafts requiring Save & Publish?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically valid, but the choice changes an existing user-visible persistence workflow and cannot be inferred safely from tests or implementation quality alone.

options.title: Approve review-only drafts
options.body: Adopt the safer draft workflow, preserve explicit HTTP auto-merge for other callers, and ensure the UI makes the required Save & Publish step clear.

options.title: Retain immediate persistence
options.body: Keep the current Control UI auto-merge behavior and close or substantially revise this PR rather than changing the established workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve review-only drafts
recommendation.body: Adopt the safer draft workflow, preserve explicit HTTP auto-merge for other callers, and ensure the UI makes the required Save & Publish step clear.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the original introduction and repeated maintenance of the Nostr profile HTTP surface.
